judgments.reason: The model text states the sequence: the winner pays the bid, then receives the three-coin commission; it does not claim the commission is applied before payment nor that bids may exceed available coins to win.
The game text and the model both describe sealed bids remaining private and do not assert that waiting reveals committed rival bids; the model did not articulate such a mechanism.
The model explicitly states '[close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold.' It does not support the claim that 'close' can settle while lots remain unauctioned.
The model distinguishes catalog purchases from auction wins and does not state that the three-coin auction commission applies to catalog buys; no mechanism substituting the objective is articulated.
